scope: Complete per-stroke comparison against private Korean dictionary playback; licensed centerlines only, no official exam-body certification.

entries.notes: All twelve source strokes inspected. Metal stroke seven rises right; the final 欠 sweep branches from the upper part of the long fall rather than below its midpoint. Other order, boundaries and form agree.

correctedReview.notes: Reinspected all twelve corrected stages. Metal stroke seven rises right; the final 欠 sweep begins on the upper part of its long fall and remains continuous.

entries.notes: All sixteen stages inspected. 立 begins with a vertical mark, 日 middle/bottom bars must meet both side walls, and the final 心 dot descends visibly right. The heart cup remains one continuous downward/rightward/upward hooked stroke.

correctedReview.notes: Reinspected all sixteen corrected stages. The first 立 mark is vertical, 日 closes on both sides, and the final 心 dot descends right with a clear gap from the cup.

entries.notes: All sixteen stages inspected, with enlarged stages six through nine. The upper 口 must close above the two separate short strokes; the right short stroke descends left to the middle bar, while the left dot remains separate. The lower 口 closure and the separation of the second fire dot require correction.

correctedReview.notes: Reinspected all sixteen corrected stages. Both 口 frames close; the first short dot remains between the mouth and middle bar, the second begins below the mouth and falls left to the bar, and all four fire dots remain distinct.

entries.notes: All sixteen source stages inspected. Both short strokes below the first 口 must start separately below its baseline; the right short stroke descends left to the long middle bar. The lower 心 cup and both final dots agree in order and direction.

correctedReview.notes: Reinspected all sixteen stages after the final spacing corrections. Both short 喜 strokes start below the first 口; the 心 cup and final right dot remain separate from the lower mouth, while their single-stroke directions and turns match the source.

entries.notes: All fifteen source strokes inspected. 女 order agrees. The upper 口 right side must reach its bottom bar, with both following short strokes beginning below the mouth; the left short dot remains separate from the middle bar and the right short fall reaches it.

correctedReview.notes: Reinspected all fifteen corrected stages. 女 retains its three-stroke sequence; the upper 口 closes, the following short strokes are detached from it, and the lower 口 remains intact.

entries.notes: All sixteen source stages inspected, with enlarged stages thirteen through sixteen. The 羊 vertical starts at the first bar. The 戈 curved hooked stroke begins separately below 羊, and its crossing left fall must finish independently of the neighboring lower hooked stroke. The compound thirteenth stroke and final dot agree in direction.

correctedReview.notes: Reinspected all sixteen corrected stages. 羊's vertical begins at its first bar; the lower compound hook is retained, the curved 戈 starts below 羊 with a gap, and its crossing fall ends independently of the neighboring hook.

entries.notes: All seventeen stages inspected. The source 示 has a long near-vertical left fall and straight right vertical, rather than the candidate's short diagonal dots. The upper 喜 mouth is followed by two short strokes that start separately below its bottom bar.

correctedReview.notes: Reinspected all seventeen corrected stages after shortening the left extent of 喜's middle bar. 示 has the source's long side strokes; its right stroke stays separate from 喜, and the two short 喜 strokes start below 口.
